reason: Use explicit practical thresholds before the remaining main online, source-actor and multiobjective outcomes are inspected. These study thresholds are not community standards, significance tests or evidence of improvement.

development_promotion.development_route_requirement: Development promotion uses complete GRT, provenance and matched-budget gates. Detailed routing is a mandatory subsequent confirmation gate; it is not silently required for an otherwise unmeasured development candidate.
development_promotion.tie_break: Lowest complete development mean native GRT wirelength among eligible methods; retain the declared default anchor if no new method passes.
development_promotion.uncontrolled_comparisons: A reused BC without an effective-update equivalence certificate is descriptive and cannot alone establish a controlled Q-treatment improvement. Different teacher evolution or replay must be reported as the total adaptive method effect.

primary_endpoint.aggregation: Mean of eight predeclared outputs within each training seed, then equally weighted mean across all three training seeds.

secondary_acceptance_rules.comparison: Candidate minus the matched BC at its declared original round; all values are native metric means.
secondary_acceptance_rules.WNS_ns: Candidate signed WNS may be no more than 0.02 ns below BC.
secondary_acceptance_rules.TNS_ns: The increase in max(-TNS,0) may not exceed max(1 ns, 0.05 times the BC violation magnitude).
secondary_acceptance_rules.horizontal_overflow_sum: The increase may not exceed max(1 native sum unit, 0.05 times the BC value).
secondary_acceptance_rules.vertical_overflow_sum: The increase may not exceed max(1 native sum unit, 0.05 times the BC value).
secondary_acceptance_rules.Power_W: No more than 1 percent above the BC mean.
secondary_acceptance_rules.StdCellArea_um2: No more than 1 percent above the BC mean.
secondary_acceptance_rules.reference_claims: Report current-flow and public-reference deltas separately. Passing the BC rule does not establish superiority to FlowPlace or its behavior flow.

failure_accounting.unknown_infrastructure_outcomes: Inconclusive; do not manufacture PPA or classify them as physical failures.
failure_accounting.baseline_physical_failures: Report feasibility and success-conditional PPA separately; conditional WL alone cannot establish superiority.

detailed_route_gate.timing_power_area_tolerances: Use the same WNS, TNS, power and area tolerances above on the separately denominated first4 DRT outcomes.

improvement_or_tradeoff_rule.overall_improvement: All primary, secondary, feasibility and detailed-route gates pass. This is an operational study classification, not statistical significance.
improvement_or_tradeoff_rule.tradeoff: The complete primary rule passes but any secondary or detailed-route quality gate fails; report the actual continuous changes without an overall PPA improvement claim.
improvement_or_tradeoff_rule.no_stable_gain: The primary rule fails, even if an individual output, seed or secondary metric improves.
improvement_or_tradeoff_rule.inconclusive: Any required request or integrity/provenance gate remains unresolved.
improvement_or_tradeoff_rule.always_report: All seven native GRT metrics, six final DRT metrics, failures, per-seed means, paired deltas and sample SD, including results that fail these gates.
